summary: A corpus case may now state `snapshot:` instead of `knows:` -- a REAL room at a REAL past instant -- and evals/backbone._drive() seeds it through nora.subject.sandbox.sandbox_from_snapshot() into the case's own isolated sandbox. The two shapes are mutually exclusive and converge on the same know(), so a converted case is driven by the same stores and rendered by the same prefill as a hand-authored one; only where the content came from changes.
details: Why: every one of the 150 cases seeded hand-authored fictional dialogue. A case whose input never occurred cannot measure behaviour on the inputs Nora actually receives -- measured against production, only 21 of the 150 cases' transcripts exist anywhere in the real message history (operator decision, 2026-09-21).

`snapshot:` states platform, conversation_id, before_ms, culture_key and unit. load_corpus() refuses a case stating BOTH snapshot: and knows: (two ways to say what she knew, with nothing making them agree and the loser invisible in the file), and refuses an incomplete snapshot BY NAME -- culture_key and unit especially, because nora.infra.sql.snapshot refuses to derive them and a wrong one reads exactly like a room that had no culture and no notebook, i.e. a case that would grade a prefill missing the very block it is about.

A snapshot case is seeded at the case's OWN instant: _drive() passes now_ms derived from the case's `now:` when it states one, so the reconstructed room is read as-of the moment the case claims to happen rather than as-of the run. leave_room_for_arrival is forwarded per entry point (sandbox.py gained the parameter), so an entry point that delivers the judged input itself does not have that message seeded twice.

11 mechanical tests (no DB/network): 8 loader tests covering the shape, the both-stated refusal and each of the five missing-field refusals by name; 3 routing tests pinning that a snapshot case reaches sandbox_from_snapshot, that it carries the case's own instant, and that the per-entry-point window rule still applies. All 3 routing tests confirmed red with the branch disabled.
